name: Container
layerWhy: It arranges other parts by space; it keeps no promise to the person of its own.
promise: Content at a width that reads, or the full width when the product needs it.
expectation: A centred column with the gutter at its edges.
evidence: Reading width by default; data-width="full" for app surfaces (decision 11).
behaviour: Centred; the gutter grows with the screen.
failures: Never a card around the page.
